The '''Drunk Droid''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] chain which operated locations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including several on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]<ref name="ShadowOfRevan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>, as well as after the [[War against Zakuul]] on [[Mek-Sha]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], being still in business around [[3624 BBY]]<ref name="Legacy" />. Locations could be recognized by their distinctive logo of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] drinking through a straw<ref name="Onslaught" >''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy" /> though several other holo-signs were used as well, all featuring the "Drunk Droid" inscription.<ref name="ShadowOfRevan" />
